name: What equipment or attire do I need for a breathwork session at Cave Training?
description: You need comfortable, loose-fitting attire and a water bottle; Cave Training provides mats and props, so no specialized equipment is required.

mainEntity.name: What equipment or attire do I need for a breathwork session at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: For breathwork sessions at Cave Training, you generally don't need specialized equipment. Comfortable, loose-fitting attire that allows for full range of motion and unrestricted breathing is ideal. You might want a water bottle to stay hydrated. We provide mats and any necessary props to support comfortable positioning. The focus is on your breath and body, so minimal external requirements ensure you can concentrate on the practice.
